# Tailrocks: Rust Project Audit

`tailrocks-rust-project-audit` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-rust-project-audit)

Audit an existing Rust workspace against the strict project baseline and report exact gaps without changing files or installing tools. Use tailrocks-rust-project-remediate only when the user approves fixes.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

> Use `tailrocks-rust-project-audit` …

Arguments: `<project path or audit scope>`
